title: SOML Project Memory Profile
description: Generic product-manager-oriented schema in which a software project's ProductContext is the top-level status and orientation root for roadmap, architecture, engineering governance, verification, and security memory.

provenance.applicability: Generic; the originating projects are provenance and are not required by the schema.
provenance.note: Candidate named profile; not a ratified SOML standard.

rootConvention.lookupValueRule: Use the software project's stable name.
rootConvention.role: Top-level product status and orientation root
rootConvention.statusRule: Explicit product-manager judgement supported by child evidence; never mechanically derived from child statuses.
rootConvention.updateRule: After a decision, merged slice, or material discovery, update affected evidence nodes and explicitly reconsider the root summary and status.

usage.isolationRule: Reach project-specific memory through its ProductContext and do not connect leaf nodes across contexts solely by thematic similarity.
usage.relationshipReason: Optional concise provenance explaining why the relationship is asserted.
